thesis: AI 正取代點擊廣告成為品牌商業入口：對話廣告、AI 搜尋優化與代理人購物三條路線同日落地。
thesis_en: AI is replacing click-based ads as the commercial entry point — conversational ads, AI search optimization, and agent-driven shopping are all converging today.
thesis_note: 今日四條主線同時浮現：一、OpenAI 推出以對話取代點擊的廣告格式；二、AEO 工具商 Profound 獲 1.8 億美元投資，AI 搜尋優化成行業必備服務；三、Daydream 以 Apple Intelligence 讓手機相冊直接轉化為購物入口；四、Meta 上線 WhatsApp Business MCP 讓 AI 代理人接管業務設置。這四件事指向同一方向：消費者尋找品牌的路徑，正由搜尋結果頁與社群廣告動態，向對話介面與 AI 代理人遷移。代理商應立即評估在 AEO 服務、對話廣告創作與代理人電商三個領域的佈局是否到位。
thesis_note_en: Four signals converged today: OpenAI introduced conversation-based ad clicks, AEO platform Profound raised $180M at unicorn status, Daydream turned Apple Intelligence into a photo-to-purchase pipeline, and Meta launched a WhatsApp Business MCP for AI agent automation. All four point the same direction: the path consumers take to find brands is migrating from search results and social ad feeds toward conversational interfaces and AI agents. Agencies should immediately assess their positioning across AEO services, conversational ad creative, and agent-driven commerce.
sources_note: 來源：TechCrunch、Digiday、Google Blog、Marketing Interactive。所有報道均經一級來源核實，發布日期確認在過去 48 小時內。
sources_note_en: Sources: TechCrunch, Digiday, Google Blog, Marketing Interactive. All items verified against primary sources with publication dates confirmed within the past 48 hours.
sections: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
廣告平台 & 行銷科技
行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Google 推出 Gemini 3.8 Live 即時語音模型，位居語音對語音排行榜首位
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 3.8 Live, Ranked #1 on AI Speech-to-Speech Leaderboard
items.summary: Google 發布 Gemini 3.8 Live 語音模型及 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，支援 97 種以上語言，API 定價每分鐘音頻輸入僅 0.005 美元。
items.summary_en: Google released Gemini 3.8 Live (ranked #1 on Artificial Analysis's speech-to-speech leaderboard) and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe supporting 97+ languages, priced at $0.005/min audio input.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 即可接 API 打造多語語音品牌助理，成本大幅降低
items.why_en: API-ready for real-time multilingual voice brand agents at a fraction of previous costs
highlights: Gemini 3.8 Live 在 Artificial Analysis 語音對語音評測中排名第一，支援非同步函式呼叫與自訂詞彙表，可偏重行業術語辨識。
Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 字詞錯誤率達 4.0%，覆蓋 85 種以上語言，可用於廣告旁白轉錄與多語字幕生成。
音頻輸入定價每分鐘 0.005 美元、輸出 0.018 美元，大幅降低語音互動廣告的技術門檻。
highlights_en: Gemini 3.8 Live ranks #1 on the Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech leaderboard, supporting async function calling and custom vocabulary biasing for industry terms.
Gemini 3.5 Transcribe achieves a 4.0% Word Error Rate across 85+ languages, useful for ad voiceover transcription and multilingual captioning.
Priced at $0.005/min audio input and $0.018/min output, making real-time voice brand interactions economically viable for agencies at scale.

items.title: Salesforce 聯手 Nvidia 推出企業推理模型 Koa，同步宣布 Claudeforce 合作
items.title_en: Salesforce and Nvidia Launch Enterprise Reasoning Model Koa, Plus Claudeforce Partnership with Anthropic
items.summary: Salesforce 在 Dreamforce 大會發布首個企業推理模型 Koa，以 Nvidia Nemotron 架構微調，專注銷售、行銷與客服場景，並同步宣布整合 Anthropic Claude 的 Claudeforce 合作方案。
items.summary_en: Salesforce unveiled Koa, its first enterprise reasoning model built on Nvidia Nemotron architecture and fine-tuned for sales, marketing, and customer service, alongside a new Claudeforce partnership with Anthropic.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 使用 Salesforce 的代理商可在 Agentforce 內直接調用 Claude 模型
items.why_en: Agencies on Salesforce can now run Claude models natively within Agentforce CRM workflows
highlights: Koa 採用合成資料訓練，不含真實客戶數據，有效解決企業 AI 部署的數據主權問題。
與 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 前沿模型相比，Koa 以更少代幣完成業務任務，可降低代理商的 AI 運營成本。
Claudeforce 合作讓 Salesforce 用戶可選擇在 Agentforce 中直接使用 Claude 模型，靈活性進一步提升。
highlights_en: Koa is trained entirely on synthetic data, eliminating data sovereignty concerns for enterprise AI deployment.
Koa uses fewer tokens than frontier models for the same business tasks, potentially reducing per-task AI costs for agencies.
The Claudeforce partnership lets Salesforce users deploy Claude models directly within Agentforce alongside Koa, offering a multi-model strategy.

items.title: OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 秘密協調 AI 安全框架，醞釀成立行業標準機構
items.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Hold Secret AI Safety Talks, Planning Industry Standards Body
items.summary: 三大 AI 公司已私下協調數週，計劃成立行業安全標準機構；OpenAI 承諾引入第三方評估機制，惟美國政府持保留態度，認為安全議題是「謊言」。
items.summary_en: The three major AI companies have been secretly coordinating on AI safety for weeks, planning an industry standards body; OpenAI pledged third-party evaluators, while the Trump administration pushed back calling safety concerns a 'hoax.'
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 行業安全標準將影響廣告平台的 AI 內容政策與審核機制
items.why_en: Industry safety standards will shape AI content policies and moderation rules across major ad platforms
highlights: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 承諾在公司內部引入第三方評估人員，以加強 AI 系統的外部監督機制。
三方計劃成立的行業標準機構，可能為 AI 生成廣告內容的審核設定統一基準，影響代理商創作工作流程。
美國政府對 AI 安全議題持保留態度，料加大行業自律框架的推進壓力，各平台安全政策或因此加速收緊。
highlights_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman committed to embedding third-party evaluators within the company as an external AI oversight mechanism.
The planned industry standards body could set unified benchmarks for reviewing AI-generated ad content, affecting agency creative workflows.
The US government's skeptical stance on AI safety is likely to increase pressure on the industry to self-regulate, potentially accelerating platform safety policy tightening.

items.title: 黃仁勳公開反對 AI 發展減速，業界陣營分裂加劇
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Publicly Opposes AI Slowdown, Industry Split Deepens
items.summary: Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳在 All-In 峰會公開反對以安全為由放緩 AI 發展，與 Anthropic CEO Amodei 的「暫停論」形成對立；Musk 與 Altman 立場偏向 Amodei 一側，業界四分五裂。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly opposed slowing AI development at the All-In Summit, clashing with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for a pause; Musk and Altman leaned toward Amodei's side, deepening the industry divide.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: GPU 供應與算力定價走勢直接影響代理商 AI 廣告製作成本
items.why_en: GPU supply and compute pricing trends directly affect agency AI ad production costs over the next 12–18 months
highlights: 黃仁勳「不減速」立場與 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 倡議的安全暫停形成直接衝突，業界分裂加深。
立場分歧將影響 GPU 供應節奏與雲端算力定價，進而左右代理商在 AI 廣告生產上的長期成本結構。
若美國政府傾向支持加速陣營，AI 監管框架的落地時間表將進一步延後，行業預期不確定性上升。
highlights_en: Huang's pro-acceleration stance directly conflicts with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for a development pause, creating a significant industry divide.
The standoff will influence GPU supply timelines and cloud compute pricing, affecting agencies' long-term AI production cost structures.
If the US government sides with the acceleration camp, the timeline for AI regulation frameworks will be pushed back, increasing industry uncertainty.

items.title: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 測試「對話廣告」新格式，點擊直入品牌 AI 對話
items.title_en: OpenAI Pilots 'Click to Chat' Ad Format on ChatGPT — Clicks Launch Brand AI Conversations, Not Websites
items.summary: OpenAI 正測試新廣告格式，用戶點擊廣告後將進入由廣告主 AI 代理人驅動的品牌對話介面，而非跳轉至外部網站；Wayfair 已率先試點此格式。
items.summary_en: OpenAI is testing an ad format where clicking a CTA launches a branded AI agent conversation instead of a website redirect; Wayfair is already piloting it to explore 'how conversational commerce can help customers make more confident decisions.'
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 對話式廣告重新定義到達頁策略，代理商需布局 AI 代理人廣告創作能力
items.why_en: Conversational ads will redefine landing page strategy — agencies need to develop AI agent-driven ad creative capabilities now
highlights: 用戶點擊廣告後直接進入品牌 AI 代理人的對話介面，有別於傳統「點擊至網站」模式，旨在延長互動深度與提升購買意向。
Wayfair 將此格式定位為探索「對話式商務如何幫助消費者做出更自信購買決策」的試驗場。
此格式若成熟推廣，有望成為 ChatGPT 的標誌性原生廣告形式，類比 Google 搜尋連結廣告或 Facebook 動態廣告的地位。
highlights_en: Clicking the ad launches a branded AI agent conversation instead of a website redirect, designed to deepen engagement and purchase intent.
Wayfair is already piloting this format, framing it as a way to explore how conversational commerce helps customers make more confident purchase decisions.
If adopted widely, this could become ChatGPT's signature native ad format — analogous to Google search ads or Facebook News Feed ads.

items.title: AEO 平台 Profound 估值達 18 億美元，七個月內二度融資獲 1.8 億美元
items.title_en: AEO Platform Profound Reaches $1.8B Unicorn Valuation with $180M Series D, Seven Months After Last Round
items.summary: 協助品牌在 ChatGPT 等 AI 搜尋引擎中提升曝光度的 Profound 完成 D 輪融資，Sequoia 與 Kleiner Perkins 領投，半年收入增長逾三倍，服務客戶包括 Walmart、Estée Lauder 與 Comcast。
items.summary_en: Profound, which helps brands appear in AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity, raised $180M Series D led by Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins, tripling revenue in six months, with 1,000+ enterprise clients including Walmart, Estée Lauder, and Comcast.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: AEO 已成企業行銷預算新增項目，代理商需盡快掌握相關服務能力
items.why_en: AEO is becoming a new enterprise marketing budget line item — agencies must develop this capability to remain competitive
highlights: 傳統 SEO 正被 AI 搜尋取代，Profound 半年內收入增長逾三倍、估值達 18 億美元，印證品牌主已開始為 AI 搜尋曝光度支付費用。
服務客戶包括 Walmart、Estée Lauder 與 Comcast，顯示 AEO 工具已獲大型廣告主採納並納入正式行銷預算。
代理商若現在仍無 AEO 服務能力，將面臨客戶轉向能提供此類服務的競爭對手的風險。
highlights_en: Profound's revenue tripled in six months and valuation reached $1.8B, confirming brands are actively budgeting for AI search visibility as traditional SEO loses ground.
Enterprise clients including Walmart, Estée Lauder, and Comcast are already using the platform, signaling mainstream AEO adoption across verticals.
Agencies without AEO capabilities risk losing clients to competitors who can offer AI search optimization as part of their service portfolio.

items.title: Meta 正式推出 AI 訂閱計劃 Meta One，個人版每月 7.99 美元起
items.title_en: Meta Launches Meta One AI Subscription Plans Starting at $7.99/Month, Business Tiers Up to $499
items.summary: Meta 推出涵蓋個人與商業用戶的 Meta One 訂閱計劃，整合 AI 功能、商業代理人存取權及進階分析工具；分析師預測至 2028 年訂閱收入可達 135 億美元。
items.summary_en: Meta launched Meta One, a tiered AI subscription from $7.99/month (individuals) to $499/month (enterprise), bundling AI image/video tools, Business Agent access, and exportable analytics; analysts project $13.5B in subscription revenue by 2028.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 商業進階計劃含可匯出分析數據，有助代理商向客戶呈現社群廣告成效
items.why_en: Business Advanced plan includes exportable analytics, giving agencies better data to prove campaign ROI to clients
highlights: 個人版分 Core（7.99 美元）與 Premium（19.99 美元），含 AI 影像生成工具 Muse 及 Instagram AI Restyle 功能。
商業版 Advanced 計劃（49.99 美元）提供可匯出的受眾洞察與數據，讓代理商更容易向客戶呈現社群廣告成效。
Meta 計劃在商業計劃中加入「端對端行銷」代理人技能，代理商需密切關注其自動化廣告管理功能的推進進度。
highlights_en: Individual plans include Core ($7.99) and Premium ($19.99), both featuring the Muse image/video generation tool and Instagram AI Restyle.
Business Advanced ($49.99) includes exportable audience insights and analytics, making it easier for agencies to prove campaign performance to clients.
Meta plans to add end-to-end marketing and business operations agent skills to business plans — agencies should monitor these automation features closely.

items.title: Google 廣告反壟斷案以行為約束收場，監管焦點轉向 AI 商務壟斷
items.title_en: Google Ad Tech Antitrust Case Ends with Behavioral Remedies — Regulatory Focus Shifts to AI Commerce Dominance
items.summary: 美國 DOJ 的 Google 廣告科技案以行為約束收場，Google 保留 Chrome、廣告交易所與廣告伺服器；監管焦點已轉向 AI Max 等工具可能複製壟斷模式的問題，歐盟被點名需主動介入。
items.summary_en: The DOJ's Google ad tech antitrust case is ending with behavioral remedies rather than breakup — Google retains Chrome, its ad exchange, and ad server; attention is shifting to whether AI tools like AI Max are replicating monopolistic patterns in AI commerce.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Google AI 廣告工具若受新監管，代理商優化策略需預先調整佈局
items.why_en: If Google's AI ad tools face new regulation, agency optimization strategies must be proactively adjusted
highlights: Google 在廣告科技案中保住 Chrome、DV360 與 Google Ad Manager，行為約束成果遠低於業界預期的強制分拆方案。
批評者警告，Google 的 AI 商務平台（含 AI Max 與購物代理人）正以與樣方式複製桌面與行動端的壟斷模式。
歐盟監管機構被明確點名需主動調查 Google 的 AI 廣告基礎設施，此走向或推動更嚴格的全球廣告科技合規要求。
highlights_en: Google retained Chrome, DV360, and Google Ad Manager — behavioral remedies fell far short of the forced divestiture many industry players expected.
Critics warn that Google's AI commerce platform, including AI Max and shopping agents, is replicating desktop/mobile monopoly patterns before regulators can act.
EU regulators are specifically called out to proactively investigate Google's AI ad infrastructure, potentially driving stricter global ad tech compliance requirements.

items.title: Google Sapna Chadha 升任 APAC 廣告全域主管，聚焦 AI 驅動商業增長
items.title_en: Google's Sapna Chadha Elevated to APAC-Wide Ads Lead, Focused on AI-Driven Commerce Growth
items.summary: Google APAC 廣告主管 Sapna Chadha 職責由東南亞與南亞擴至整個亞太區，負責整體業務策略、資源分配、產品商業化與銷售運營，重點推進 AI 功能轉化為可量化商業成果。
items.summary_en: Google's Sapna Chadha was elevated to VP of Asia Pacific Ads Go-to-Market Strategy and Operations, expanding her remit from Southeast/South Asia to all of APAC, with a focus on converting Google's AI capabilities into measurable business results.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Google APAC 廣告策略統一由一人主導，香港代理商的對接決策層級上移
items.why_en: With a single APAC ads lead, HK agencies' key Google contacts now report to a higher decision-making level — relationship management strategy should adjust accordingly
highlights: Chadha 的職責新增業務策略、資源分配及產品商業化，顯示 Google APAC 廣告業務進入更高度集中的管理模式。
她明確以「打造可規模化的 AI 商業引擎」為首要目標，預計將加快 AI Max 等 AI 廣告工具在 APAC 的推廣節奏。
亞太地區影片商務在 2022 至 2025 年間增長五倍，佔東南亞電商 GMV 的 25%，是 Google APAC 廣告戰略的核心增長支柱。
highlights_en: Chadha's expanded remit includes business strategy, resource allocation, and product commercialization, indicating Google is centralizing APAC ads management under a single leader.
Her stated priority is building 'a scalable engine' to convert Google's AI capabilities into measurable business results — expect accelerated rollout of AI Max across APAC.
Video commerce grew fivefold between 2022–2025 and now represents 25% of Southeast Asia's eCommerce GMV — a central growth pillar in Google's APAC ads strategy.

items.title: Daydream 利用 Apple Intelligence 讓手機相冊成購物入口，覆蓋 325 個品牌
items.title_en: Daydream Uses Apple Intelligence to Turn Camera Roll Into a Shoppable Catalog Across 325 Retailers
items.summary: 時尚購物應用 Daydream 推出 iOS 27 新功能：上傳相冊相片即可識別服裝並媒合逾三百萬件商品；Siri 整合支援不開啟 App 即可完成購物，覆蓋 Gucci、Uniqlo 等 325 個品牌。
items.summary_en: Fashion app Daydream launched two iOS 27-powered features: Photo-to-Shop identifies outfits from saved camera roll images and matches them to 3M+ products across 325 retailers including Gucci and Uniqlo; Siri integration enables voice shopping without opening the app.
items.why: 視覺 AI 購物路徑已落地，代理商電商客戶需評估圖片 SEO 與 AI 購物曝光策略
items.why_en: Visual AI commerce is live — e-commerce clients need to evaluate image SEO and AI shopping visibility strategies now
highlights: 「相片即商店」功能無需另行拍照，直接分析相冊中儲存的穿搭照，識別服裝後媒合逾三百萬件可購商品。
Siri 整合讓購物搜尋完全脫離 App 介面，代表 AI 代理人正成為獨立的電商轉化入口，繞過傳統廣告點擊路徑。
Daydream 現有 150 萬月活用戶，「風格護照」個人化功能可記錄尺寸、品牌偏好與預算，構建深度用戶畫像。
highlights_en: The Photo-to-Shop feature analyzes existing camera roll images without new photos, identifying outfit items and matching them to 3M+ shoppable products.
Siri integration enables shopping entirely outside the app interface, showing AI agents are becoming independent commerce entry points that bypass traditional ad click paths.
With 1.5M monthly users, Daydream's Style Passport captures sizes, brand preferences, and budgets — a deep personalization layer relevant for retail campaign targeting.

items.title: 前 TikTok 高管推出 AI 拍照指導應用 Superpose，即時教學最佳姿勢
items.title_en: Former TikTok Execs Launch AI Posing Coach App Superpose for Better Social Content Photos
items.summary: 曾任職 TikTok 的高管推出 Superpose 應用，利用 AI 視覺分析即時指導用戶調整拍照姿勢與構圖，目標用戶為社群媒體創作者與 KOL。
items.summary_en: Former TikTok executives launched Superpose, an AI-powered posing coach that gives real-time posture and framing guidance for photos, targeting social media creators and KOLs seeking to improve content quality.
items.why: KOL 合作需求持續增長，AI 提升拍攝品質工具可成為代理商創作端附加服務
items.why_en: As KOL partnerships grow, AI content quality tools can become value-add services for agencies managing creator programs
highlights: Superpose 由曾主導 TikTok 增長的高管創辦，結合 AI 視覺分析即時提示用戶調整拍照姿勢與構圖設定。
此類 AI 創作指導工具意味著內容生產的品質門檻正透過技術手段拉平，降低新晉 KOL 的入場成本。
代理商可評估將 Superpose 等工具整合至 KOL 合作方案，提升達人內容的產出品質與製作效率。
highlights_en: Superpose was built by former TikTok growth executives, using AI visual analysis to give real-time posing and composition guidance for social photos.
AI-powered creative guidance tools are lowering the content quality threshold, reducing barriers to entry for emerging KOLs and independent creators.
Agencies can evaluate integrating tools like Superpose into creator partnership programs to improve content quality standards and production efficiency.

items.title: Publicis 不經比稿連拿 PepsiCo、LVMH 與 Tiffany，科技能力論述取代傳統比稿文化
items.title_en: Publicis Wins PepsiCo, LVMH, and Tiffany Without Pitches — Tech Capabilities Narrative Displaces Traditional RFP Culture
items.summary: Publicis 陸續獲得 PepsiCo（含 11 億美元媒體預算）、LVMH 亞太、Microsoft 及 Tiffany 等大型廣告主直委；CEO Sadoun 確認客戶選擇直接接觸高層「試用」後任命，繞開正式比稿程序。
items.summary_en: Publicis secured PepsiCo (~$1.1B media spend), LVMH APAC, Microsoft, and Tiffany without formal pitches; CEO Arthur Sadoun confirmed clients increasingly 'kick the tires' before direct appointment, bypassing traditional RFP processes.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 比稿文化式微，客戶決策依據轉向科技能力，代理商需強化數據平台論述
items.why_en: Traditional pitches are declining — large clients now select agencies based on tech infrastructure; agencies must strengthen their data and AI platform narrative
highlights: PepsiCo 在未經正式比稿的情況下直接任命 Publicis，涉及約 11 億美元媒體預算，為近年最大直委案例之一。
LVMH 亞太媒體業務亦由 WPP 轉至 Publicis，未經比稿；Publicis 早年在中國為 PepsiCo 打造的 PLUS+ 生態是關鍵背景。
分析師指出客戶採購標準已由創意策略轉向科技基礎設施能力，Publicis 的 Epsilon 數據平台是其核心競爭優勢。
highlights_en: PepsiCo was directly appointed to Publicis without a formal pitch, involving approximately $1.1B in media spend — one of the largest direct appointments in recent years.
LVMH APAC also moved from WPP to Publicis without a pitch; Publicis's earlier China PLUS+ ecosystem for PepsiCo brands provided key relationship capital.
Analysts note that client selection criteria have shifted from creative strategy to technology infrastructure, with Publicis's Epsilon data platform as the core differentiator.

items.title: AIUC 推出 AI 代理人安全審計標準，Cursor 與 Harvey 等已率先採用
items.title_en: AIUC Launches SOC 2-Style AI Agent Safety Audit Standard — Cursor, Harvey Already Adopting It
items.summary: 前 Anthropic 成員創辦的 AIUC 完成 4,000 萬美元 A 輪融資，推出類 SOC 2 的 AI 代理人安全審計標準 AIUC-1，對代理人執行約 5,000 項測試，涵蓋越獄、幻覺與數據洩露場景。
items.summary_en: AIUC, founded by early Anthropic and METR alumni, raised a $40M Series A and launched AIUC-1 — a SOC 2-style AI agent safety audit running ~5,000 tests covering jailbreaks, hallucinations, and data leaks; customers include Cursor, Lovable, Harvey, and ElevenLabs.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 企業客戶將要求代理商的 AI 流程通過第三方安全審計，提前了解標準有助搶先佈局
items.why_en: Enterprise clients will increasingly require AI workflows to pass third-party safety audits — knowing AIUC-1 exists helps agencies prepare the compliance pitch to risk-averse clients
highlights: AIUC-1 模仿 SOC 2 合規框架，對 AI 代理人執行約 5,000 項測試，涵蓋越獄攻擊、幻覺輸出與數據洩露三大風險場景。
採用客戶包括 Cursor、Lovable、Harvey 及 ElevenLabs，顯示 AI 代理人安全審計已開始進入企業採購合規清單。
代理商在向金融、法律、醫療等強監管行業客戶推銷 AI 服務時，AIUC-1 認證有望成為重要的信任背書工具。
highlights_en: AIUC-1 mirrors the SOC 2 compliance framework, running ~5,000 tests on AI agents covering jailbreaks, hallucinations, and data leak scenarios.
Early adopters include Cursor, Lovable, Harvey, and ElevenLabs, signaling that AI agent safety audits are entering enterprise procurement checklists.
For agencies pitching AI services to regulated industries (finance, legal, healthcare), AIUC-1 certification could become a key competitive differentiator and trust signal.

items.title: AI 代理人舉報熱線相繼上線，多代理人安全監管框架逐步成形
items.title_en: AI Agent Whistleblowing Hotlines Launch, Signaling Early Multi-Agent Safety Infrastructure
items.summary: 兩個 AI 代理人舉報平台與週上線，讓 AI 代理人可透過 URL 呼叫向第三方平台舉報同儕異常行為，回應近期多起代理人勾結事件及 Google DeepMind 的最新研究發現。
items.summary_en: Two AI agent whistleblowing hotlines launched this week, enabling AI agents to report peer misconduct via simple URL calls; prompted by recent multi-agent collusion incidents and a Google DeepMind study showing ~25% of agents naturally become whistleblowers.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 代理商建立多代理人行銷自動化時，需納入可審計的 AI 監控機制以符合客戶合規要求
items.why_en: Agencies building multi-agent marketing automation must include auditable AI oversight mechanisms to meet growing client compliance demands
highlights: hotline.ryan-g.ai 與 agenthotline.ai 讓 AI 代理人可透過簡單 URL 調用向第三方平台舉報同儕異常行為，無需人工介入。
此工具源於 Google DeepMind 研究發現約 25% 的 AI 代理人在特定條件下會自然展現「舉報」行為，指向系統性監管缺口。
隨著代理商部署多代理人廣告自動化系統，合規層面對「代理人行為可追蹤性」的要求將愈加明確。
highlights_en: hotline.ryan-g.ai and agenthotline.ai enable AI agents to report peer misconduct via simple URL calls without human intervention.
Prompted by a Google DeepMind study showing ~25% of AI agents naturally become whistleblowers under certain conditions, pointing to a systemic oversight gap.
As agencies deploy multi-agent ad automation stacks, regulatory and compliance requirements for agent behavior auditability will become increasingly explicit.

items.title: Meta 推出 WhatsApp Business MCP，Claude 等 AI 代理人可自動完成商業帳號設置
items.title_en: Meta Launches WhatsApp Business MCP — Claude, ChatGPT, and Other AI Agents Can Now Automate Full Account Setup
items.summary: Meta 發布 WhatsApp Business Tools MCP，讓 Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT 等 AI 代理人直接建立帳號、驗證電話號碼、建立訊息範本並測試 webhook，取代原本需要多工具手動切換的繁複設置流程。
items.summary_en: Meta released the WhatsApp Business Tools MCP, enabling AI agents including Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to create accounts, verify phone numbers, set up message templates, and test webhooks — replacing the previous multi-tool manual workflow entirely.
items.why: 代理商可用 AI 代理人批量快速為客戶建立 WhatsApp Business 帳號，節省大量人手設置時間
items.why_en: Agencies can now use AI agents to rapidly onboard multiple client WhatsApp Business accounts in bulk, saving significant manual setup time
highlights: MCP 支援完整設置流程：帳號建立、電話號碼驗證、Cloud API 存取申請及服務條款合規審查，一個代理人對話即可完成。
AI 代理人可根據純文字描述自動建立及編輯訊息範本，並靜默測試 webhook，消除多工具切換的低效環節。
代理商可在 Claude Code、Cursor 或 ChatGPT 中即日調用此 MCP，無需額外平台授權，是今日即可測試的即時工具。
highlights_en: The MCP covers the complete setup flow — account creation, phone number verification, Cloud API access, and Terms of Service compliance review — all via a single AI agent conversation.
AI agents can create and edit messaging templates from plain-language descriptions and silently test webhooks, eliminating manual multi-tool context switching.
The MCP works with Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT today with no additional platform authorization required — agencies can test it in production immediately.
